page: Microsoft Azure ND96is_MI300X_v5 is a high-density, GPU-accelerated virtual machine designed for intensive artificial intelligence, machine learning, and parallel computing workloads. Operating under Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance runs on dedicated Intel x86_64 processors providing 96 vCPUs. At the core of its computational profile is an array of eight AMD Instinct MI300X accelerators delivering an aggregate 1536 GB of high-bandwidth GPU memory, enabling substantial model weights to reside directly across the accelerated memory pool.

The host environment pairs its accelerator subsystem with 1850.0 GB of system memory, representing approximately 19.27 GB of RAM per vCPU. Local storage is provisioned via an integrated 31,820 GB NVMe SSD pool alongside capability for Azure Premium Storage. The local solid-state capacity enables high-throughput data staging, checkpoint persistence, and raw training dataset caching without bottlenecking on external storage networks.

From a cost efficiency and architectural perspective, aggregating eight high-capacity accelerators and nearly 32 TB of local NVMe storage onto a single dedicated node minimizes inter-node communication latency for massive models. A noted tradeoff includes the absence of complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring deliberate network edge architecture. The ND96is_MI300X_v5 is primarily tailored for large language model training, generative AI fine-tuning, large-scale deep learning inference, and complex scientific simulations.
description: Microsoft Azure ND96is_MI300X_v5 is an isolated, GPU-accelerated server instance designed for large-scale artificial intelligence and compute-intensive workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture using dedicated Intel processors, the instance delivers 96 vCPUs paired with 1850.0 GB of system RAM. Acceleration is driven by eight AMD Instinct MI300X GPUs offering a cumulative 1536 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM. The instance also integrates 31,820 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage and maintains support for Premium Storage tiers. This dense hardware consolidation maximizes data throughput and reduces multi-node communication latency when handling memory-heavy deep learning architectures. By grouping massive accelerator memory and extensive local NVMe capacity into a single host, it delivers strong resource density for enterprise deployments. The ND96is_MI300X_v5 is suited for large language model training, multi-GPU distributed fine-tuning, high-batch inference serving, and advanced scientific modeling.
